facts.text: ASME V&V 10, V&V 20 and V&V 40 are American Society of Mechanical Engineers standards on verification and validation: V&V 10 addresses structural models, V&V 20 addresses fluid-flow and heat-transfer models, and V&V 40 addresses risk-based model credibility for medical devices.
facts.quote: V&V 10 for structural models, V&V 20 for fluid-flow and heat-transfer models, and V&V 40 for judging model credibility by risk, written for medical devices.

facts.text: The American Society of Mechanical Engineers runs a program of verification, validation and uncertainty quantification (VVUQ) standards.
facts.quote: ASME runs a program of verification, validation and uncertainty quantification (VVUQ) standards.

facts.text: The 2019 edition of ASME V&V 10, Verification and Validation in Computational Solid Mechanics, covers models of structures and solids.
facts.quote: V&V 10 (Verification and Validation in Computational Solid Mechanics, 2019 edition) covers models of structures and solids.

facts.text: ASME V&V 20 covers computational fluid dynamics and heat transfer, emphasizing computation of validation uncertainty.
facts.quote: V&V 20 covers computational fluid dynamics and heat transfer, with emphasis on computing validation uncertainty.

facts.text: The booklet relies most on ASME V&V 40 (2018), Assessing Credibility of Computational Modeling through Verification and Validation: Application to Medical Devices, among the three ASME V&V standards.
facts.quote: V&V 40 (2018), Assessing Credibility of Computational Modeling through Verification and Validation: Application to Medical Devices, is the one the booklet relies on most.

facts.text: ASME V&V 40 introduces the question of interest and context of use, and defines model risk as model influence combined with decision consequence.
facts.quote: It introduces the question of interest, the context of use, and model risk as model influence combined with decision consequence

facts.text: ASME V&V 40 asks that model credibility goals be set in advance to match model risk.
facts.quote: asks that credibility goals be set in advance to match that risk

facts.text: ASME V&V 10 and ASME V&V 20 were named but not verified in the booklet's research.
facts.quote: V&V 10 and V&V 20 were named but not verified in its research

facts.text: The booklet read ASME V&V 40 through guidance from the US medical regulator that adopts the standard.
facts.quote: V&V 40 was read through the US medical regulator's guidance that adopts it.

facts.text: ASME VVUQ 30.1-2024 covers scaling methods for nuclear thermal-fluid applications.
facts.quote: A related document, ASME VVUQ 30.1-2024, covers scaling methods for nuclear thermal-fluid applications

facts.text: The booklet calls ASME V&V 40 the most transferable reasoning framework for the heavy off-road collision mitigation validation program, but limits its applicability to physics-based models.
facts.quote: The booklet calls V&V 40 "the most transferable reasoning framework" for this program, with one limit: it applies to physics-based models only.

facts.text: If perception software uses a machine-learned detector, the ASME V&V 40 framework covers vehicle-dynamics and brake models but not the neural network; the neural network needs separate assurance.
facts.quote: If the perception software uses a machine-learned detector, the framework covers the vehicle-dynamics and brake models but not the neural network, which needs separate assurance
